JLTV.nomenclature: TRUCK, UTILITY, JOINT LIGHT TACTICAL VEHICLE

remark_templates: Veh exhibited trans fluid leak from output shaft area during ops. Approx {leak_rate} on ground after overnight. Traced to output seal failure IAW {tm_ref}. Replaced seal and gasket set, refilled trans fluid. Road tested {test_miles} mi, no further leak.

Trans fluid found pooling under rear of veh during post-ops PMCS. Output seal deteriorated, metal shavings found in drain pan. Replaced output seal assy and gasket set per {tm_ref}. Fluid analysis sent to oil lab.
Operator reported slipping during gear changes at speed. Checked trans fluid level -- 2 qts low. Found output seal weeping. Replaced seal, topped off fluid, test drove. Shifting normal.

faults.description: Central Tire Inflation System manifold fault
remark_templates: CTIS fault light illuminated during convoy ops. System unable to maintain {tire_psi} PSI in {tire_position} tire. Inspected manifold valve -- cracked housing. Replaced manifold valve and {hose_count} hoses per {tm_ref}.

Operator reported CTIS malfunction -- all four tires losing pressure simultaneously. Traced to cracked manifold valve. Replaced valve assy and tested system. All tires holding at {tire_psi} PSI highway.
Veh lost power under load on grade, black smoke from exhaust. Turbo not spooling -- actuator rod seized. Deadlined. Requires turbo assy replacement per {tm_ref}. POC: {mechanic}.
Intermittent power loss reported during convoy. Turbo boost gauge reading {boost_psi} PSI (normal {normal_boost} PSI). Wastegate actuator failed open. DL'd pending turbo replacement.
Veh failed to start during morning dispatch. Battery voltage {voltage}V under load (min 24V). Batteries past service life ({battery_months} months). Replaced both batteries per {tm_ref}.
Voltage regulator fault -- alternator output {alt_amps}A (spec {spec_amps}A). Batteries draining during ops. Replaced alternator and both batteries.

faults.description: Brake pad / rotor wear to safety minimum
remark_templates: Brake wear indicator triggered during PMCS. {position} pads at {pad_mm}mm (min 3mm). Rotors scored. Safety deadlined. Replacing pads and rotors {axle} axle per {tm_ref}.
Operator reported grinding noise during braking. Inspected -- {position} brake pads worn to backing plate. Rotors below min thickness. DL'd for safety. Replacing all {axle} brake components.
Temp gauge climbing during low-speed ops. Coolant pump weeping at weep hole. Replaced pump and thermostat per {tm_ref}. Pressure tested system, no leaks.
Engine ran hot during convoy, driver secured prior to overheat. Pump bearing noisy on cold start. Replaced pump assy and flushed cooling system.

faults.description: Air brake system moisture / valve failure
remark_templates: Air system low-pressure warning during morning dispatch. Air dryer discharged water at PM check. Replaced dryer cartridge and relay valve per {tm_ref}. Leak tested at {pressure} PSI.
Service brake pedal soft, stopping distance increased on ops. Relay valve internal leak found. Replaced valve, tested service and parking brake, pass.
CTIS unable to hold highway setting on {tire_position} wheel. Inspection found cracked hose at wheel hub. Replaced {hose_count} hoses and tested. CTIS cycling normally.
Controller display blank intermittent. Traced to failed controller module. Replaced and reprogrammed presets per {tm_ref}.
Veh would not crank at morning formation. Voltage to starter good, solenoid clicking only. Replaced starter and solenoid per {tm_ref}. Cranks and starts normally.
Intermittent no-crank condition over past week. Starter bendix chipped. Replaced starter assy, verified ring gear intact.
Fluid puddle under transfer case, confirmed output seal leak. Additional whine under load. Replaced seal kit and chain assy per {tm_ref}.
Operator reported vibration at highway speed. Transfer case chain stretched beyond spec. Replaced chain and seal kit.
Engine temp near redline during sustained uphill. Fan clutch not engaging. Radiator core cracked at upper tank. Replaced radiator and fan clutch per {tm_ref}.
Pressure test revealed seeping core tube. Core replaced, coolant flushed.
CPC inspection found active corrosion on frame rail and cross member, no perforation. Wire wheeled, primed, painted per CARC SOP. Returned to service.
Monthly CPC cycle -- rust blooms on bed. Surface prep and paint applied.
Boom unable to extend past half stroke under load. Pressure gauge {pressure} PSI (spec {spec_pressure} PSI). Pump internal wear. Replaced pump and HP hoses per {tm_ref}.
Winch dropping load under brake. Seal leak at pump case. Pump replaced, system purged, winch tested to 5K lbs.

faults.description: Air brake leak at trailer coupling
remark_templates: Audible air leak at glad hand coupling during recovery ops. Replaced glad hand kit and trailer air line. Tested to {pressure} PSI, no leak.
Air pressure loss with trailer attached. Glad hand seals cracked. Replaced per {tm_ref}.
PTO switch inop. Harness at PTO housing chafed through. Replaced harness, taped and secured cable routing per {tm_ref}.
Trailer ST/TA lamps non-functional. Traced to broken wire in connector. Repaired connector and tested.
During tow-and-roll recovery, engine temp climbed above 220F. Pump weeping at shaft seal. Replaced pump, flushed and refilled.
LHS load-roll-off cycle stalled mid-stroke. Cylinder rod weeping, {leak_rate} under load. Replaced cylinder per {tm_ref}. Cycle time {cycle_time}s after repair, within spec.
Crane slew cylinder leaking at gland seal. Seal kit installed, system purged, tested to rated capacity.
Knocking from rear during load transitions. Walking beam bushings worn out of round. Replaced bushings per {tm_ref}, torqued to spec.
Scheduled PMCS found bushing play on {side} walking beam. Replaced kit.

faults.description: Auto transmission harsh shifts / fluid overheat
remark_templates: Trans overtemp alarm during loaded convoy. Cooler core restricted, fluid at {egt_temp}F. Replaced cooler and temp sensor, flushed fluid.
Harsh 2-3 shift reported. Temp sensor faulty, reading erratic. Replaced sensor, verified shift points.
ABS warning light illuminated. DTC indicates {tire_position} wheel speed sensor open circuit. Replaced sensor and harness connector. Code cleared, no return.
ABS modulator not releasing on panic stop test. Replaced modulator valve, bled system, retested.
PMCS found {tire_position} tire below tread depth minimum. Sidewall good. Replaced tire, balanced per {tm_ref}.
Tire punctured by road debris. Unable to plug due to sidewall location. Replaced tire.
Trailer marker lamps not functioning during PMCS. Replaced {hose_count} lamp assemblies and verified ground path.
Right rear stop / tail / turn inop. Wiring corroded at pigtail. Repaired wiring and replaced lamp.
Audible air leak at {side} brake chamber. Diaphragm perforated. Replaced chamber, adjusted slack per {tm_ref}.
CPC inspection found active rust on bed stake pockets and cross members. Wire wheeled, primed, painted. Return to service.
Output voltage {voltage}V unloaded (spec 240V). Fluctuating under load. Replaced voltage regulator per {tm_ref}. Output within 2% spec.
Generator will not build voltage. Regulator field coil open. Replaced regulator and tested.
Generator dies under load. Fuel lift pump not priming. Replaced pump, bled system, tested.
Overtemp shutdown during extended run. Thermostat stuck closed. Replaced thermostat, topped off coolant.
Frequency drifting under load {alt_amps}Hz (spec 60Hz). Governor actuator response sluggish. Replaced actuator per {tm_ref}. Verified freq hold under full load.

M1A1_ABRAMS.nomenclature: TANK, COMBAT, FULL TRACKED, 120MM GUN, M1A1

remark_templates: Track tension {side} side measured {tension_in} inches (spec {spec_tension} +/- 0.5 in). {shoe_count} track shoes cracked / missing pads. Replaced shoes, adjusted tension IAW {tm_ref}.
During post-ops, {side} track found loose with {throw_count} thrown end connectors. Reinstalled connectors, replaced {shoe_count} damaged shoes, retensioned to {spec_tension} in. per {tm_ref}.
FCS boresight failed during gunnery prep. Gunner's primary sight {param_desc}. Unable to maintain zero beyond {range}m. DL'd for FCS alignment per {tm_ref}. Evacuated to IMA. POC: {mechanic}.
Tank crew reported engagement accuracy degraded during live fire. FCS diagnostics show {error_code} fault in {subsystem}. Requires depot-level calibration. Evacuating to {ima_unit}.

Turbine exhaust temp exceeding {egt_temp}C (max {max_egt}C) at idle. Power output insufficient for grade operations. Suspected FOD damage to first stage turbine blades. DL'd pending engine R&R. Evacuated to {ima_unit}.
Engine flameout during operations. Multiple restart attempts failed. Inspection found debris in intake plenum. Turbine section damage confirmed. Requires complete powerpack R&R. Evacuating.
Turret slew speed reduced, audible groan under load. Pump discharge pressure {pressure} PSI. Replaced pump and HP hoses per {tm_ref}. Travers checked within spec.
Hydraulic fluid puddle beneath turret basket. Traced to hose failure at swivel. Replaced hose assy.
TC unable to transmit on crew intercom, loader / gunner working. Control module backplane connector corroded. Replaced control per {tm_ref}. Crew net verified.

M88A2_RECOVERY.nomenclature: RECOVERY VEHICLE, FULL TRACKED, M88A2 HERCULES

remark_templates: Main winch unable to produce pulling capacity during casualty recovery EVAL. Pressure {pressure} PSI under load. Winch motor leaking from case drain. Replaced motor and main pump per {tm_ref}.
Winch drum not reversing. Motor swashplate stuck. Replaced motor, tested retrieval under load.
Track chucking noted during road ops. {shoe_count} track shoes cracked or with missing pads. Replaced shoes and {throw_count} end connectors, retensioned.
Engine produces heavy exhaust smoke under load, power reduced. Turbo shaft play out of spec. DL'd for engine R&R at IMA. POC: {mechanic}.

MRAP_RG31.nomenclature: MINE RESISTANT AMBUSH PROTECTED VEHICLE, RG-31

remark_templates: Cabin temperatures exceeding 100F during ops in Okinawa summer heat. Compressor clutch not engaging, blower motor noisy. Replaced compressor and blower per {tm_ref}. System charged, operating 45F vent temp.
HVAC inop in crew compartment. Blower armature shorted. Replaced blower and tested.

faults.description: Armor panel mounting hardware loose / corroded
remark_templates: PMCS discovered {hose_count} armor panel bolts loose or corroded on hull side. Replaced bolts and torqued to spec per {tm_ref}. Loctite applied.
Veh will not crank. Battery load test fail on {hose_count} of 4 batteries, {battery_months} months in service. Replaced full battery bank per {tm_ref}. Verified charging voltage {voltage}V.
Coolant loss with no external leak. EGR cooler internal leak confirmed by pressure test. Replaced cooler and gaskets per {tm_ref}.
Turret traverse sluggish in power mode, manual operation normal. Motor amperage high, brake dragging. Replaced motor and brake per {tm_ref}. Verified travers rate.
Turret will not power travers past 90 deg. Traced to shorted winding in traverse motor. Replaced motor.
{tire_position} tire losing {tire_psi} PSI over 12 hours. Leak at wheel hub seal. Replaced wheel station assembly per {tm_ref}.
LAV produces excessive exhaust smoke, boost low at {boost_psi} PSI. Turbo shaft play detected, manifold crack found. Replaced turbo and manifold per {tm_ref}.
Power loss on grade. Turbo bearing seized. DL'd, turbo R&R completed.
Range degraded on command net. VHF amplifier output below spec. Replaced amp per {tm_ref}. Range check nominal to BN net.
Launcher elevation drifting under static hold. Hydraulic cylinder internal leak, deflection exceeding {deflection}mm tolerance. DL'd for cylinder R&R at IMA per {tm_ref}. POC: {mechanic}.
Launcher fails to hold elevation setting during pre-fire checks. Evacuating to {ima_unit}.
Sight alignment fail during dry-fire exercise. Thermal channel shows {param_desc}. Evacuating to {ima_unit} for calibration per {tm_ref}. POC: {mechanic}.

faults.description: Engine coolant pump failure (shared LAV powerpack)
remark_templates: Coolant pump weeping at shaft seal. Replaced pump and refilled cooling system per {tm_ref}.
CPC inspection found rust blooms on lower hull sponson. Wire wheeled, primed, painted.

faults.description: Proprotor gearbox chip light / oil sample
remark_templates: PRGB chip detector illuminated in cruise. Oil sample FE count above limit. DL'd for PRGB R&R at IMA. POC: {mechanic}.
Scheduled oil sample showed increasing ferrous wear trend. PRGB replacement initiated per {tm_ref}.
Nacelle {side} side slow-to-convert during airplane to helo transition. Actuator internal leak. Replaced actuator per {tm_ref}. Conversion cycle time {cycle_time}s within spec.
Mission computer reports {error_code} fault on startup BIT. Boot loops during alignment. Replaced computer per {tm_ref}. System configured and verified.
Hydraulic quantity low indication post-flight. Leak traced to FCS manifold flange. Manifold replaced, system purged per {tm_ref}.
Pilot reported 1/rev feedback in cyclic. Track and balance showed {deflection} deg lead-lag excursion on {side} blade. Damper replacement scheduled per {tm_ref}.
Main transmission chip light illuminated cruise. Oil sample FE wear elevated. DL'd for transmission R&R. POC: {mechanic}.
APU hot start trip on run-up. Fuel control governor out of spec. Replaced fuel control unit per {tm_ref}. Start time {cycle_time}s nominal.
Hydraulic quantity low post-flight. FCS servo external leak confirmed. Replaced servo, system purged, leak test nominal.

Launcher rail alignment check failed during pre-fire. Rail deflection exceeding [REDACTED] mil tolerance. Unable to achieve required [REDACTED] accuracy standard. DL'd pending IMA rail alignment per {tm_ref}. POC: {mechanic}.
FCS reported launcher indexing error during dry fire exercise. Rail assembly showing {deflection}mm lateral play (max [REDACTED]mm). Safety deadlined. Evacuating launcher module to {ima_unit}.

Launcher elevation cycle time degraded -- {cycle_time} sec (spec {spec_time} sec). Hydraulic pump output below {flow_rate} GPM minimum. Pump showing scoring on gears. Replacing pump and associated hoses per {tm_ref}.
Hydraulic fluid leak at launcher elevation cylinder. {leak_rate} fluid loss per hour. Traced to high-pressure hose fitting. Replaced hose assy and checked system pressure -- {pressure} PSI nominal.
FCS self-test fail, error {error_code} on boot. Unable to complete MOK alignment. Evacuating to {ima_unit} per {tm_ref}. POC: {mechanic}.
Intermittent power loss to launcher module during ops. Distribution box corrosion on output bus. Replaced box per {tm_ref}, dielectric grease applied.

Phased array calibration exceeding [REDACTED] threshold during BIT. {affected_elements} T/R modules showing degraded output. System unable to maintain [REDACTED] beam accuracy. DL'd for depot-level calibration per {tm_ref}. POC: {mechanic}.
G/ATOR self-test failure during power-on sequence. Error code {error_code} -- array calibration fault. Performance degraded below [REDACTED] operational threshold. Evacuating to depot.

Coolant temp alarm during sustained ops. Cooling pump not cycling -- motor burned out. System auto-shutdown to prevent array damage. Replaced pump assy per {tm_ref}. Coolant levels nominal after repair.
Radar shut down after {runtime_hours} hrs continuous ops. Cooling system fault -- pump output zero flow. Overtemp protection activated. Pump motor seized. Ordered replacement.
Data link encryption failed during net check. KGV-72 fill device will not accept key. Replaced device S/N USMC-{seq} per {tm_ref}. Rekeyed and net tested. POC: {mechanic}.
Primary power output dropping during warm-up. Power module capacitors bulged. Replaced module per {tm_ref}.
Antenna slewing stops intermittently during scan. Slip ring carbon brushes pitted. Replaced slip ring and brushes per {tm_ref}. POC: {mechanic}.
Unable to transmit on command net from radar. Radio set output low. Replaced radio and verified ops.
Shelter interior temp exceeding limits during ops. ECU compressor seized. Replaced ECU and recharged.
Target track drops after acquisition. Signal processor self-test error {error_code}. Replaced card per {tm_ref}. POC: {mechanic}.

D7G_DOZER.nomenclature: TRACTOR, FULL TRACKED, LOW SPEED, D7G

remark_templates: Track wear beyond pitch spec {shoe_count} shoes both sides. Replaced shoes and adjusted per {tm_ref}.
Blade tilt cylinder weeping at rod seal. Replaced cylinder per {tm_ref} and purged system.
Final drive oil sample showed metallic contamination exceeding limit. {side} side final drive to be replaced per {tm_ref}. DL'd.
Low oil pressure indication, engine shutdown. Oil pump worn. Replaced pump and bearings per {tm_ref}.
Bucket lift cylinder will not hold load, bleeds down. Rod packing seal failed. Replaced cylinder per {tm_ref}.
Transmission slipping in 2nd and 3rd. Powershift valve internal leak. Replaced valve and filter per {tm_ref}.
Engine overheating under heavy loader ops. Radiator core clogged with fines. Replaced radiator and flushed system per {tm_ref}.
{tire_position} tire wear exceeded spec, sidewall cracking. Replaced tire per {tm_ref}.
Product water rejection rate below 95%. RO membrane elements fouled, no recovery after CIP. Replaced {hose_count} membrane elements per {tm_ref}. Quality verified.
HP pump unable to reach {pressure} PSI feed pressure. Pump piston seals damaged. Replaced pump per {tm_ref}.
Chlorine residual reading low. Metering pump not stroking. Replaced pump assy.
